newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rato sees three pct 1997 economic growth in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Rato sees three pct 1997 economic growth in Spain.

text.p: Spain's Economy Minister, Rodrigo Rato said on Friday he expects Spain's economy to grow by three percent next year, helped by stronger consumption and investment demand.

"We expect a three percent GDP (Gross Domestic Product) growth pushed by a strong consumption and investment demand, that will have been in turn spurred by some levels of interest rates that have never been seen before," Rato told bankers at a congress in Frankfurt.
Rato said he also foresees an increase in employment of 240,000 new jobs.
